CONTEXT BUDGET CEILING REACHED - HAND OVER
This session measures 260000 tokens, over the 180000 ceiling.
Do not stall the fleet: keep working, and tell the captain at the next natural reply.
When you do hand over, the handover mechanism owns it:
  1. Run /stow to write durable knowledge, decisions, and unfinished work to disk.
  2. Load the handover skill and release the helm with bin/fm-handover.sh.
  3. A successor session picks the work up from disk; nothing here clears a context.
This is a warning: the ceiling does not block by default.
This is a cost and reasoning-quality policy, not an overflow warning.
